mapper.sql: rr.id, rr.verification_id AS verificationId, rr.user_id AS userId, rr.request_type AS requestType, rr.reason, rr.status, rr.reviewer_note AS reviewerNote, v.original_name AS originalName, v.verdict, v.score, DATE_FORMAT(rr.reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regDt, DATE_FORMAT(rr.upd_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updDt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_request ( verification_id, user_id, request_type, reason, status ) VALUES ( #{verificationId}, #{userId}, #{requestType}, #{reason}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'PENDING') )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM review_request rr INNER JOIN verification v ON v.id = rr.verification_id WHERE rr.verification_id = #{verificationId} AND rr.user_id = #{userId} AND rr.status IN ('PENDING', 'REVIEWING') ORDER BY rr.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM review_request rr INNER JOIN verification v ON v.id = rr.verification_id WHERE rr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rr.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE review_request SET status = #{status}, reviewer_note = #{reviewerNote}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
